chunks: They will have safety from the mighty terror, and angels will receive them, (saying:) "This is your day which had been promised you."

key_terms.الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ: The mighty terror / the great fright

ai.seo_question: What happens to the believers on the Day of Resurrection regarding fear and angels?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-faza' al-akbar' (the greatest terror) is often identified with the specific awe of the Day of Judgment or the moment of death, from which the righteous are shielded by divine grace. The angels' greeting not only confirms the fulfillment of the prophetic promise but also signifies the transition from the world of action to the world of recompense, highlighting the believers' serene acceptance of their destiny.
